# RGUARD

> RGUARD is a Russian digital agency creating viral vertical videos, SMM production, advertising concepts, scripts, AI content, corporate films, and event media for industrial B2B and real-sector companies.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://rguard.ru/): Viral videos for industrial and real-sector companies.
- [Cases](https://rguard.ru/cases): Case studies with campaign goals, solutions, metrics, and video examples.
- [Viral Videos](https://rguard.ru/viral): Viral video production for industrial audiences.
- [Production and SMM](https://rguard.ru/production): Content strategy, production, posting, analytics, and SMM management.
- [Scripts](https://rguard.ru/scripts): Scriptwriting for viral videos and advertising formats.
- [Campaign Concepts](https://rguard.ru/concepts): Creative concepts for advertising and PR campaigns.
- [Events](https://rguard.ru/events): Event organization and event video production.
- [Industries](https://rguard.ru/industries): Industry-specific content solutions.
- [Articles](https://rguard.ru/articles): Articles about viral content and industrial marketing.
- [Contacts](https://rguard.ru/contacts): Phone, office address, and official social links.
